shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Toasts only; panels carry no shadow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Press feedback, toasts, board digit roll, route line growth.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per screen: Add expense / Save.
components.css: .ds-btn-signal { height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; background: #f6c400; color: #121212; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 650 15px 'Anek Latin', sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms ease, transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-signal:hover { background: #ffd21f; } .ds-btn-signal:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Segmented Range
components.description: Date range control; active segment inverts to ink with yellow text.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #121212; background: #fff; } .ds-seg button { height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #dcddd7; background: none; font: 550 14px 'Anek Latin', sans-serif; } .ds-seg button:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true] { background: #121212; color: #f6c400; }

components.name: Station Board
components.description: Signature: the total on a station board.
components.css: .ds-board { background: #f6c400; padding: 8px; } .ds-board > div { border: 3px solid #121212; padding: 18px 26px; font-family: 'Anek Latin', sans-serif; } .ds-board p { margin: 0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-board .f { font-size: 88px; font-weight: 760; font-stretch: 122%; line-height: 1; margin: 8px 0; }

components.name: Line Roundel
components.css: .ds-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 400 14.5px 'Anek Latin', sans-serif; } .ds-line .b { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; border: 3px solid #1d5fbf; background: #fff; box-sizing: border-box; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Square field; ink border and inner ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #dcddd7; border-radius: 0; font: 400 15px 'Anek Latin', sans-serif; outline: 0; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #121212; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #121212; }

narrative.overview: Ledger reads like a railway platform: the total is a yellow station board with its caption, categories are metro lines, entries read like a timetable. The world lends type, palette, density and one signature move; every control stays a standard web control.
keyCharacteristics: Yellow only on board, active state, primary action
Delhi Metro line colours for categories
Anek variable type, width axis as display voice

rules.name: Spending Up Is Red
rules.body: A rise in spending is red, a fall green; colour says good or bad.

rules.name: Yellow Is Scarce
rules.body: Signal yellow appears only on the board, the active state, and the primary action.

rules.name: Width Is the Display Voice
rules.body: Emphasis comes from Anek's width axis and weight, not a second face.

dos: Do give every category a line colour and roundel
Do name the baseline of every change
Do keep screens within the viewport
donts: Don't add KPI tiles, donuts, gradients or rounded cards
